name: mysqldump 逻辑备份诊断
description: mysqldump 是 MySQL 最常用的逻辑备份工具，产出 SQL 文本文件。核心参数选择决定备份质量：--single-transaction 保证 InnoDB 一致性快照（不锁表）、--master-data/--source-data 记录 binlog 位点用于搭建从库、--routines --triggers --events 备份存储过程和触发器。大库（> 50GB）备份慢是主要痛点，可考虑 mysqlpump（多线程）或 mydumper。

root_causes.name: 关键参数遗漏导致备份不一致或不完整
root_causes.desc: 未用 --single-transaction 导致 InnoDB 表备份不一致。未用 --routines/--triggers/--events 漏掉存储过程和触发器。未用 --set-gtid-purged=ON 导致从备份搭建从库时 GTID 信息丢失。

root_causes.name: 大库备份耗时过长
root_causes.desc: mysqldump 单线程导出，100GB 库可能需要 4-8 小时。备份窗口不够用。解决：mydumper 并行导出或改用 XtraBackup 物理备份。

root_causes.name: 备份期间影响线上性能
root_causes.desc: --single-transaction 开启长事务，期间 undo log 无法 purge，可能导致 ibdata1 膨胀。备份读取大量数据可能污染 buffer pool。

root_causes.name: 恢复速度慢
root_causes.desc: 逻辑备份恢复是逐行 INSERT，比物理备份恢复慢 5-10 倍。可通过关闭 autocommit、foreign_key_checks、unique_checks 加速。

step1_db_size.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, COUNT(*) AS table_count, ROUND(SUM(DATA_LENGTH + INDEX_LENGTH)/1024/1024/1024, 2) AS total_gb, SUM(TABLE_ROWS) AS total_rows FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql','information_schema','performance_schema','sys') GROUP BY TABLE_SCHEMA ORDER BY total_gb DESC

step2_non_innodb.desc: 检查非 InnoDB 表（--single-transaction 不保证其一致性）
step2_non_innodb.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ENGINE, TABLE_ROWS FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE ENGINE != 'InnoDB' AND TABLE_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql','information_schema','performance_schema','sys')

step3_routines_triggers.desc: 检查是否有存储过程、触发器、事件需要备份
step3_routines_triggers.sql: SELECT 'PROCEDURE' AS type, ROUTINE_SCHEMA, ROUTINE_NAME FROM information_schema.ROUTINES WHERE ROUTINE_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql','sys') UNION ALL SELECT 'TRIGGER', TRIGGER_SCHEMA, TRIGGER_NAME FROM information_schema.TRIGGERS WHERE TRIGGER_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql','sys') UNION ALL SELECT 'EVENT', EVENT_SCHEMA, EVENT_NAME FROM information_schema.EVENTS

step4_gtid_status.sql: SELECT @@gtid_mode AS gtid_mode, @@server_uuid AS server_uuid, @@global.gtid_executed AS gtid_executed
